answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Attestations are tied to bonded identities, so a false claim traces back to its owner. Like a vine climbing a trellis, standing grows only as verified work accumulates. Auditors compare records at the wharf, and a clean onyx-dark history is hard to fake.
